source: User-uploaded translation-strategy-ab-review.csv; includes all original output columns plus reviewer status/notes. Review judgments used as supplied; independent reviewer identity not authenticated.
logic: Candidate pre-registration requires >=27/30 ACCEPT and >=3 net additional ACCEPT per direction with zero newly introduced critical errors and p95 ratio <=2.5. Observed gains are zero (linewise 21/30 ID->EN and 22/30 EN->ID, equal to whole) and candidate is slower in both directions. Other timing/safety checks cannot substitute for failure to improve acceptance.
evaluated_data_limits: Paragraph sources were specifically authored before experiment; not the original CP4 60 single-sentence translation benchmark.
Reviewed statuses may reflect human decisions but no reviewer authentication/independent blind validation is available in uploaded file.
Uploaded review includes original output fields but not original device raw CSV bytes; can't assert direct raw SHA match.
58/60 exact identical output pairs; two text changes are accepted synonyms/grammar changes without status benefit.
ID->EN whole first row 563.170ms is a likely warmup outlier, but p95 and median comparisons do not depend on mean alone.
All recorded battery proxy values in review show 36C, not CPU temperature or a real 10-minute application video test.
No producer model, dataset, fixture, historical review labels, or CP4 gate adjusted.

generated_user_reports.location: ChatGPT conversation artifacts; only SHA/source provenance and summaries committed to GitHub

next_step: Close whole-vs-linewise quality hypothesis for this 60-paragraph diagnostic. Keep current translator unchanged; prioritize next real 10min video E2E instrumentation and/or a separately pre-registered genuine translation model candidate. Do not rescore the original frozen gate.
